job.title: Full Stack Engineer (DevOps & Cloud) bei adesso – Münster

tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of enterprise experience building, extending and supporting large-scale e-commerce platforms (SAP Commerce Cloud 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, RESTful APIs, microservices, cloud deployments, CI/CD pipelines, and database performance tuning. Proven delivery of PIM, ERP and MDM integrations. Certified SAP Commerce Cloud Developer combining deep backend engineering with techno-functional business analysis.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
cover_en.hook: Bringing over 5 years of specialized experience in building and optimizing enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud for global clients such as Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited to apply for this SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer role. My background combines deep backend engineering in Java and Spring with hands-on integration and cloud delivery across SAP Commerce Cloud environments.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Architecture
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing and customer data management following platform best practices.

bullets.label: REST APIs & Integration
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services for headless commerce storefronts, alongside customized Interceptors, Populators and Converters for seamless data flows.

bullets.label: Enterprise Data Pipelines
bullets.text: Engineered PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub to synchronize product catalogs across global channels and integrated SAP ERP and MDM platforms.

bullets.label: Cloud & CI/CD Delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows, managing custom extensions and platform maintenance through HAC.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit. I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, making me available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my SAP Commerce expertise adds value to your projects.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer
cover_de.hook: Mit mehr als 5 Jahren spezialisierter Erfahrung in der Entwicklung, Erweiterung und Betreuung von Enterprise-E-Commerce-Plattformen auf Basis der SAP Commerce Cloud bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundierte Expertise für Ihr Team mit. Meine Stärke liegt in der robusten Backend-Entwicklung mit Java und Spring sowie in der erfolgreichen Umsetzung komplexer Integrations- und Cloud-Projekte.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Entwicklung
bullets.text: Konzeption und Implementierung von Backend- und Frontend-Funktionalitäten auf SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) mit Java und Spring für Produkt-, Katalog-, Preis- und Kundendatenmanagement.

bullets.label: APIs & Headless Integration
bullets.text: Entwicklung und Bereitstellung von OCC REST Web Services für Headless-Storefronts sowie Anpassung von Interceptors, Populators und Converters für kundenspezifische Datenflüsse.

bullets.label: Datenintegration & PIM/ERP
bullets.text: Design und Optimierung von PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines mittels Profisee, Hotfolders und DataHub zur Synchronisation von Produktkatalogen über globale Vertriebskanäle hinweg.

bullets.label: Cloud & CI/CD Deployment
bullets.text: Ausführung von CI/CD-Deployment-Zyklen und Release-Builds auf dem SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) im Rahmen agiler DevOps-Prozesse inklusive Plattformbetreuung via HAC.

cover_de.logistics: Ich lebe in Karlsruhe und verfüge über eine unbefristete deutsche Arbeitserlaubnis. Mein letzter Arbeitstag im aktuellen Beschäftigungsverhältnis ist der 15.12.2026, sodass ich ab dem 16.12.2026 für Sie tätig sein kann. Ich freue mich auf das Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: I want to apply my 5+ years of enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) and Java expertise to deliver scalable e-commerce software solutions for your clients. My hands-on background in developing REST APIs, managing cloud deployments on CCv2, and integrating complex PIM and ERP systems aligns directly with your technical scope.
tailoring.motivation_short: 5+ years SAP Commerce Cloud experience, certified developer, strong Java/Spring background and proven cloud deployment expertise ready to contribute from December 2026.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years building enterprise platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) using Java, Spring, and OCC REST APIs at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in your software engineering roles. My last working day is 15.12.2026; let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) Developer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application documents for the SAP Commerce Cloud Developer position. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise e-commerce platforms using SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, Spring, and OCC REST APIs at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring proven expertise in backend development, integrations, and cloud deployments.

I possess a valid German residence and work permit, and I am available starting 16 December 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
